{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Transwestern Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2loepG5 Transwestern Gas Pipeline,] Wikipedia, accessed September 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline connects natural gas supplies in the San Juan and Rocky Mountain Basins in northwest New Mexico, southwest Colorado, the Texas-Oklahoma Panhandle, and the Permian Basin region of West Texas and Southeastern New Mexico with California, Arizona, Nevada in the West and Texas, and New Mexico on its Eastern end.<ref name="source1" />

==Background==

=== Main Line ===
The Transwestern Gas Pipeline is operated by Transwestern Pipeline Company, a subsidiary of Energy Transfer Partners.<ref>[http://www.pdigm.com/user/file/Colorado/Energy_Transfer_Transwestern_Pipeline_Company.pdf Energy Transfer/Transwestern Pipeline Company], Energy Transfer Partners, accessed January 2018</ref>

Warren Petroleum, along with Monterey Oil Company and J. R. Butler founded the Transwestern Pipeline Company on March 11, 1957.<ref name="source1" /> Energy Transfer Partners acquired Transwestern Pipeline in 2006 from CCE Holding, a subsidiary of GE Energy Financial Services and Souther Union Company for $1.47 billion.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hartenergy.com/news/energy-transfer-partners-buy-transwestern-pipeline-48736|title=Energy Transfer Partners to Buy Transwestern Pipeline|last=|first=|date=20 September, 2006|website=Hart Energy|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=31 August, 2023}}</ref>

=== Desert Southwest Expansion ===
This expansion was proposed in August 2025 to increase delivery of gas from the Texas Waha hub to markets in New Mexico and Arizona. It was slated to become operational in Q3 of 2029, and construction costs were estimated at 5.3 billion USD.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.energytransfer.com/news-releases/news-release-details/energy-transfers-transwestern-pipeline-company-announces-binding|title=https://ir.energytransfer.com/news-releases/news-release-details/energy-transfers-transwestern-pipeline-company-announces-binding|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/energy-transfer-announces-natural-gas-123000777.html|title=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/energy-transfer-announces-natural-gas-123000777.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
